summary: Operator site + its white-label Campspot engine (book.streamsideparks.com): confirmed reservable on Campspot, nightly only; added 50-amp full hookups, 63 RV sites to 70 ft with pull-throughs, showers/laundry/WiFi, season May 1 - Oct 7 (engine closed dates), $50-95 (lowest baseline per site type). Discounts (Good Sam directory, derived) left. Base $50 is at, not over, the gate (and Glacier is a gateway anyway). Note: location corrected ('four miles west of West Glacier' -> on US-2 at West Glacier, 2.5 mi from the West Entrance per the operator); Campspot/RV Life restatements dropped.
